title: Danny Barker joins; Chicago excursion; Desvigne to 1933
summary: Sayles recommends Danny Barker for Lee Collins's band when he leaves for the boat; Barker meets Louis Armstrong and Paul Barbarin on the Chicago excursion. Sayles stays with Desvigne until about 1933.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
